hooks.command: TMPFILE=$(mktemp) && cat > "$TMPFILE"; PROMPT=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty' "$TMPFILE"); if [ -z "$PROMPT" ]; then rm -f "$TMPFILE"; exit 0; fi; TRANSCRIPT=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' "$TMPFILE"); rm -f "$TMPFILE"; TITRE=$([ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && jq -r 'select(.aiTitle != null) | .aiTitle' "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || echo ''); DATE=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'); printf '\n---\n%s [%s] %s' "$DATE" "${TITRE:-Sans titre}" "$PROMPT" >> /workspaces/maclasse/.claudeHistoriquePrompt-${USERNAME:-${USER:-$(whoami)}}.txt
